basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old recent graduate from UNSW, currently residing in Fredericksburg. I have a keen interest in gaming and discovering new communities online. I work part-time at a local workshop, which allows me to explore my love for crafting and DIY projects. I'm newly single, having recently navigated a difficult divorce. I typically browse Reddit during the evenings, often after 7 PM. I love sharing and exploring islands in games, especially during events like New Year's Eve.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in engineering from UNSW, which gave me a solid foundation in problem-solving and technical skills. Most of my knowledge about gaming and online communities comes from self-teaching and participating in various forums and Discord servers.
